headline: VikSphere
tagline: This is my space, my sphere to share with the world. Explore my creations, thoughts, experiments and experiences.
name: Vikhyat Kumar Srivastava
title: Lead Data Engineer · Solution Designer · Big Data
about: Product developer Lead with 15 years of experience in Data Engineering and Software Development. I design and build data platforms across GCP, AWS and Azure — from Spark pipelines and Medallion architectures to cloud migrations and Databricks lakehouses. Equally at home leading cross-functional teams, mentoring engineers, and writing about the ideas that fascinate me.

experience.description: Developed a data model for a German retail company. Built an ingestion pipeline based on Medallion architecture using AWS S3 and SageMaker AI. Explored data extraction from coloured graphs using linear expressions and pioneered an AI-first system delivery process.

Integrated and implemented Databricks LakeFlow Connect to build data pipelines using PostgreSQL per Medallion architecture. Evolved an in-house ingestion framework to support legacy data pipelines feeding the new data design.

experience.role: Lead Data Engineer · Solution Designer · SME
experience.description: Designed reusable ETL frameworks in Python and DBT for Banking & Finance clients. Migrated legacy on-premises applications to GCP (Dataflow, BigQuery). Achieved a 40% reduction in Spark job execution time through targeted tuning. Led cross-functional teams across requirements gathering, data warehouse design, and BDD/TDD testing strategies.
Automated manual production tasks, implemented seamless deployments, resolved complex escalated incidents, and created custom SQL/Tableau reports providing actionable insights.
Managed vendor relationships, championed change-control best practices, performed root cause analysis on production incidents, and utilised Splunk for log analysis, monitoring, and capacity planning.
Built dynamic web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery; collaborated cross-functionally to deliver projects on time.

education.institution: Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam Technical University, Lucknow
education.degree: Bachelor of Technology — Computer Science & Engineering

certifications: R Level 1 — Data Analytics with R
